text: Which genes with enhanced urinary bladder expression stain moderately or strongly in urothelial cells, have no detectable mRNA in liver, and sit at the plasma membrane?
plan: Tissue category (RNA): Urinary bladder / Tissue enhanced AND Tissue expression (IHC): Urinary bladder / urothelial cells / Medium, High AND Subcellular location (ICC): Plasma membrane AND Tissue expression (IHC): Liver / hepatocytes / Not detected
understanding: The user is querying for genes with enhanced RNA expression in urinary bladder, specific staining levels (medium/high) in urothelial cells via IHC, no detectable RNA in liver, and subcellular localization at the plasma membrane via immunofluorescence.
